key_terms.إِضْرَار: Causing harm or damage, specifically financial loss to a partner
key_terms.عِتْق: Emancipation or freeing of a slave
key_terms.وَجْه: The face/countenance of God, meaning doing it for God's sake

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for obligating the emancipation of the remaining share of a slave in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the obligation to free the remaining portion of a jointly-owned slave arises specifically when emancipation is intended to cause financial loss to the partner; otherwise, the owner is merely encouraged to complete the emancipation for the sake of God. This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of *niyyah* (intent) in determining legal obligations, separating compulsory acts from recommended ones based on the underlying motive.
